#### Circadian rhythm analysis using the R package circacompare, created by Rex Parsons[1].

This report presents the results of a circadian rhythm analysis based on the expression of mvs associated with circadian rhythms, using the R package *circacompare*, developed by Rex Parsons(1). The analysis is used to characterize circadian patterns in mv expression data and to estimate key parameters describing the rhythmic profile of the mvs under investigation.

================================================================================

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Cleaning previously objects from the current workspace
rm(list = ls())
#ls() 
# Loaging the necessary libraries
library(circacompare)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(here)

# File path. Read the README file for further instructions.

df <- read_excel(
  "data/template.xlsx", sheet="spreadsheet",
  .name_repair = "minimal"
)

df <- df[, !grepl("^\\.\\.\\.", names(df))]
```

##### 1. Specifying the mv of interest

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Entering the mv of interest.

mv <- "mv1"
cat(
 "Variable to be analyzed: ",
  mv,
  ".\n"
)
```


##### 2. Data Preparation and Removal of Missing or Invalid Values

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
df$time <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(df$time)
)

df[[mv]] <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(df[[mv]])
)

df$group <- as.factor(df$group)

cat("Summary of missing values:\n")

cat(
  "Time:",
  sum(is.na(df$time)),
  "NA. | Group:",
  sum(is.na(df$group)),
  "NA | ", mv, ":",
  sum(is.na(df[[mv]])),
  "NA\n"
)

# Data Cleaning and Removal of Missing Values (NA)  

dados_limpos <- df[
  complete.cases(
    df[, c("time", "group", mv)]
  ),
]

linhas_removidas <- nrow(df) - nrow(dados_limpos)

cat(
  linhas_removidas,
  "lines were removed.\n"
)

cat(
  "Total of valid observations:",
  nrow(dados_limpos),
  "\n\n"
)

# Checking if there is sufficient data
if(nrow(dados_limpos) == 0){
  
  stop(
    "All data was removed after the cleanup."
  )
  
}

```


##### 3. Results
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

# Circacompare analysis
result <- circacompare(
  x = dados_limpos,
  col_time = "time",
  col_group = "group",
  col_outcome = mv,
  alpha_threshold = 1
)
options(width = 60)

cat("Nonlinear regression model: \n")
summary(result$fit)

cat("Summary of results: \n")
print(result$summary)
print(result$alpha)

cat("Graph: \n")
print(result$plot)
```


##### 4. Reference
1. Rex Parsons, Richard Parsons, Nicholas Garner, Henrik Oster, Oliver Rawashdeh, CircaCompare: a method to estimate and statistically support differences in mesor, amplitude and phase, between circadian rhythms, *Bioinformatics*, Volume 36, Issue 4, February 2020, Pages 1208–1212, <https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btz730>
